activities.title: Listen to the exam-day morning. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Ingrid (repasando el plan) y Diego (nervioso pero listo).
data.script: Ingrid: Exam day plan! Wake up at seven — no later. … Diego: Alarm set. Two alarms, as always! … Ingrid: Good breakfast: eggs, bread and fruit. The brain needs fuel. … Ingrid: We arrive at the school at eight thirty, forty minutes early. … Diego: I'll bring three sharp pencils and one eraser. … Ingrid: In the exam: read the instructions twice, answer everything, check the spelling. … Diego: And after the exam? … Ingrid: After the exam… ice cream with the whole team. Captain's orders! … Diego: That's the best part of the plan!

data.script: Look at the picture. Listen and write the names. There is one example. … Diego: Who is that in the funfair? The girl with fair hair and a dark blue jacket. … Maya: That is Ingrid. Ingrid is reading the plan for the day. … Diego: And who is the boy in the red shirt with a microphone? … Maya: That is Diego. Look, Diego is asking questions with his microphone. … Diego: And who is the boy with very short hair and a white and green shirt? … Maya: That is Tino. Look, Tino is playing hockey. … Diego: And who is the girl with a red ponytail and freckles? … Maya: That is Iris. Look, Iris is drawing with chalk on the ground. … Diego: And who is the boy with short fair hair and a rucksack? … Maya: That is Samu. Look, Samu is waving.
data.voice_note: Voces: Diego (nino, reportero) pregunta y Maya (nina, cientifica) responde.
